footprints.description: Same Sky MSD-10-C hinged microSD card socket, 8 contacts + 4 shell tabs (not named in the pinout), surface mount
footprints.note: MSD-10-C.pdf p.3 Recommended PCB Layout (Top View) and p.2 mechanical drawing. Layout y is measured from the housing back edge (top line of the outline) down; origin = centre of the housing: x on the connector centre line, y = 13.80/2 = 6.90 below the back edge, so every layout y has 6.90 subtracted. Contacts: pitch 1.10, 0.80 x 1.50, #01 at x +3.20 (CL to pin 1 = 3.20 on p.2), pin n at 3.20-(n-1)*1.10 (pin 8 at -4.50, printed 4.50 left of CL); pad rows 4.65 + 5.45 = 10.10 (bottom edge) and 10.10-1.50 = 8.60 (top edge) from the back edge: centre 9.35-6.90 = 2.45. Shell tabs 1.45 x 2.00 at x +-6.88 (printed 6.88): the upper tab bottom edge is 4.65 (printed) from the back edge, so its centre is 4.65-1.00 = 3.65 -> 3.65-6.90 = -3.25; the lower tab top edge is 10.10+0.85 = 10.95 (5.45 and 0.85 printed), centre 10.95+1.00 = 11.95 -> 5.05. The pinout names no shield pad, so the four tabs are unnumbered (pin 0). Body = overall top view 14.60 x 13.80 (p.2); the contact row is shown at the front of the drawing, entry at the top, as drawn (no rotation).

footprints.description: Same Sky MSD-11-A push-pull microSD card socket, 8 contacts + CD + WP switch pads + 2 shell tabs, 2 locating holes, surface mount
footprints.note: MSD-11-A.pdf p.3 Recommended PCB Layout (Top View) and p.2. Layout x is measured from the left locating hole centre, y from the housing back edge (datum line, 11.70 to the front). Contacts P8 at x 0.20 (printed 0.20), pitch 1.10: P_n at 0.20+(8-n)*1.10 (P1 at 7.90, P1-P7 = 6.60 printed); WP at P1+1.10 = 9.00; CD at WP+1.25 = 10.25 (printed 1.25); pads 0.60 x 1.50; y from -1.10 to +0.40 about the datum (read from the vector drawing, not printed: tails project 1.10 behind the back edge) -> centre -0.35. Locating holes dia 1.40 at (0, 2.60) and (10.00, 2.60) (printed 2.60, 10.00; the drawing does not say plated, taken as non-plated pegs). Shell pads 1.50 x 2.34 (printed): left edge 2.92 left of the hole, so centre -2.92+0.75 = -2.17; right pad 15.84 wide over both (printed): outer edge -2.92+15.84 = 12.92, centre 12.92-0.75 = 12.17; centre y 7.30 (printed). CD = pin 9, WP = pin 10, shell = pin 11. Origin = centre of the housing: x = (-2.17+12.17)/2 = 5.00 (hole midpoint), y = 11.70/2 = 5.85; body 13.78 x 11.70 (p.2 overall width). The drawing has the contacts at the back and the card entry at the bottom; it is rotated 180 deg here (x and y negated about the body centre) so the card entry faces up (-y).

footprints.description: Same Sky MSD-12-A push-push microSD card socket, 8 contacts + CD switch pad + 6 shell pads, surface mount
footprints.note: MSD-12-A.pdf p.3 Recommended PCB Layout (Top View), p.2 for the body. Layout x from the outer edge of the upper-left shell pad, y from the top edge of the contact pads. p1..p8: pitch 1.10, 0.80 x 1.24 (printed), p1 centre 4.82 from the left (printed 4.82) so p_n at 4.82+(n-1)*1.10 (p1-p8 = 7.70 printed), y 0..1.24 -> centre 0.62. CD pad 1.16 x 1.25 at (14.46, 3.25) (printed 3.25, 1.16, 1.25; x read from the vector drawing: 15.04 right edge printed). Shell pads (cover ground = pin 10): upper-left 1.15 x 2.50 at (0.575, 1.25); upper-right 1.15 x 2.20 at (14.86, 1.10) (15.44 overall printed: 15.44-0.575 = 14.865); lower-left 1.15 x 2.20 at (0.575, 12.58) (printed 12.58); lower-right small 1.16 x 1.20 at (14.46, 12.25) (printed 12.25); two bottom pads 1.50 x 1.15 at x 4.88 and 12.66 (printed), y bottom edge 13.95 (printed) so centre 13.95-0.575 = 13.375. Origin: the housing is 14.14 wide (p.2) x 13.95 (the layout height 13.95 printed; p.2 says 13.80 +-0.15), centred on the shell-pad span (0.575+14.865)/2 = 7.72 and y 13.95/2 = 6.975. The shell tab x position vs the housing edge is only known to about 0.2 mm. The drawing has the contacts at the back and the card entry at the bottom; it is rotated 180 deg here (x and y negated about the body centre) so the card entry faces up (-y).

Origin: housing 14.75 x 14.50 (p.2), x centred on the connector centre line which is 0.95 (p.2) toward pad 1 from the card centre line: -0.95; y from the contact-row bottom edge 0 to 14.50 -> 7.25.
